notes.title: Update 5.0.1052
notes.notes:
Updates:

Tennis World: Physical condition computation after match has been adjusted* 

Match-sim: energy loss during quick simulation (used by Tennis World) has been a little bit decreased*

Equipment offers: little changes to improve one-time bonuses*

Modding: you can now change images for backgrounds, tactics ans other UI assets

Fixes:

New career: it was not possible to exit the creation of a player

Locker room: left handed players had a little glitch with their hand while waiting

Player: Ranking evolution impact on morale was inverted

Player: Lighting in the locker room was too much exposed

Data: a record of player Okasa was wrong*

Minor UI and texts fixes

Various optimizations to improve compatibility and performance on older systems

*: fixes only available for new careers created from this version

notes.title: Update 5.0.1005
notes.notes:
Fixes:

 Under certain conditions, some players were stuck on a blank screen after a match.
 Certain game saves from players who used the editor mode to modify game plans were stuck with an error in the calendar.

notes.title: Update 5.0.994
notes.notes:
Updates:

 Match simulation : improved game plan balancing
 Add a logo for WTL Queens tournament

Fixes:

 Match : Player's fatigue level was not impacting his performance sufficiently
 Editor mode: editing a game plan could lead to a crash under certain conditions
 Some datas could be inconsistent in the following screens: trainings, ranking history and staff profile.

notes.title: Update 5.0.971
notes.notes:
Fixes:

eagle-view: there was still some mistakes done by the system on serve box and baselines

WTL tournament points little fix

match briefing: stats displayed in Briefing were not correct (they were labelled as being for the current season, when in fact they are for the last 52 weeks)

match briefing: sometimes the opponent displayed was not the good one

match briefing: sometimes the photo of my player was not the good one

match tactics in briefing: game plan changes on briefing wasn't saved when starting a match

saves: under certain conditions, notably when attending matches as a spectator, it could happen that a save did not correctly record all the states of the matches played, which could result in replaying a match already played while our player retained the fatigue of the “forgotten” match

Update:

Tournaments WTL: add Queens, shift Nottingham and remove Birmingham*

*: fixes only available for new careers created from this version

notes.title: Update 5.0.949
notes.notes:
Fixes:

players' photos and models consistency : players from Eastern Europe and North Africa tended not to have the right morphotype. This has been corrected for 3D models* and photos.

achievements: winning the world cup did not trigger achievement (pro & junior); yes, unfortunately if you've already won it you have to win it again

match: the umbrellas on some courts were sometimes in front of the camera during end-of-match shots

modding: the eagle-view logo was not updated when modded

modding: when using a mod and editing a player's photo, the current photo from the mod was not used anymore, even without saving the edition

data: wrong rankings were displayed on screen News (1 rank offset)

navigation: screen was not updated after selecting main menu items from Tournament draw or Briefing

fantasy court : quick match stadium and surfaces were not random

minor UI and texts fixes

Updates:

ads display frequency on billboards during match have been updated

 

*: fixes only available for new careers created from this version

notes.title: Update 5.0.929
notes.notes:
Match simulation updates :

Smarter Game Plans: Winrate has been greatly rebalanced for more tactical diversity and fairer outcomes.

Sharper Lobs: Lobs are now more effective and rewarding when used at the right moment.

Faster, Shorter Rallies: Say goodbye to endless exchanges, the game features now more dynamic points!

Speed Boost Upgraded: Quicker movement boosts your chances of chasing down tight shots!

Topspin Depth Fixed: More accurate ball placement for realistic rally construction.

Serve speeds now better reflect a player's attributes: no more unexpectedly slow serves with good stats.

Other updates :

match: qualifier matches can now have a public [img src="https://statics.teams.cdn.office.net/evergreen-assets/personal-expressions/v2/assets/emoticons/smile/default/30_f.png?v=v83"]

infrastructures: the impact of sub-infrastructures on infrastructure levels has been rebalanced (infrastructure level up are easier at low levels, and harder at high levels) *

Fixes:

editor mode: attribute could have a +1 to their value (round issue)

objectives: the board was asking to upgrade infrastructure to level 10 whereas the max is 9. If you are impacted by this issue, you have to reach the end of the current season and the board will not ask you this again.

staff: the Board Director of Florida Academy was leaving his job after the first season whereas he is a permanent staff of the academy *

match: an useless shadow was displayed next to the net on the indoor stadiums

fantasy court: the behaviour and the animations of the game plans were shifted

tournaments categories names: there was an inconsistency in the category names between what was indicated for each tournament and the drop-down lists used for filtering *

Minor UI and texts fixes

*: fixes only available for new careers created from this version

notes.title: Update 5.0.908
notes.notes:
Updates :

Difficulty adjustments (easy & medium) for player recruitment negotiations

Update of the junior tournaments database to ensure better filling*

Fixes :

match : it was not possible to re-use same injunction during a match

match : eagle-view system was sometimes interacting with the net

match : eagle-view system was sometimes wrong with in/out balls

text : names of junior tournaments were in caps*

text : korean font support was missing

rare crash that occurred when playing an advanced career and then recruiting a staff in a less advanced career in the same session

past worsening injuries appeared twice in the injury history

minor localization fixes

*: fixes only available for new careers created from this version

notes.title: Hotfix 5.0.890
notes.notes:
Fixes:

 trainings : since the last update, there was an inconsistency between display and actual data, which can lead to a series of bugs
 match briefing : the opponent analysis report contained useless information about doubles and psychological attributes
 player editor : attributes were abnormally incremented by 1 after an edition
 fantasy court : game plan changes on briefing were not used in match
 fantasy court : obsolete slider attacking balance was visible on briefing
 fantasy court : the Djorovic challenge leaderboard was no more accessible
 settings : warnings about VRAM were not triggered accurately enough

Updates:

 bug reports sent from the game are now published on the channel "bug-reports" on our Discord, for a better follow-up

notes.title: Update 5.0.874
notes.notes:
Optimizations:

 the calendar duration has been accelerated, especially for long careers / heavy save files
 many memory leaks have been fixed, which improves the overall game performance (and its compatibility with low-powered machines)

Updates

 players recover more physical condition during the World Cups
 minimum rank for the main draw of J4 and J5 tournaments have been updated for a better filling of the tournaments
 'French Open' has been renamed 'Paris Open' for rights issues

Fixes:

 sometimes the images would disappear during long gaming sessions
 a parameter value was missing in game plan export to key
 unable to open youth screen after mentor is gone
 the button in the email reminder for youngs players was not leading to the right screen
 the players in the locker room tended to slip on the floor
 the tournaments of Andijan were not in the right place*
 the tournament Melbourne Open did not have the correct stadium
 the tournament Belgrade Open did not have the correct stadium 
 the tournament Belgrade Open did not have the correct surface*
 the player Alessandro Hunzike had a wrong skin color
 match : ads were not well displayed when "low" preset was selected for graphics
 minor UI and localizations fixes

*: fixes only availble for new career created from this version

notes.title: Update 5.0.850
notes.notes:
Fixes:

 The youth team could be empty at the end of the year
 Under certain rare conditions, recruiting a young player could lead to a crash later in the season
 Head to Head in the briefing was nos accessible
 Modifying a game plan did not have enough impact on its mastery indicator
 Minor UI & localization fixes

Updates:

 Form & Moral rebalancing, for a more realistic evolution of these indicators
 Minor updates on tactics illustrations
 Add dynamic ads on billboards

notes.title: Update 5.0.826
notes.notes:
Majors updates:

 Match simulation : modification of service during matches and quick matches. Players self-adjust their risk according to their first serve percentage during the match, but also according to the level of risk in the game plan.
 Form: changes to form bonuses/malus after a match according to difficulty level and opponent's relative ranking
 Crash in calendar: there was a crash in week 47 if during the career creation you started to create your player and changed your mind and coaching an existing player

Other fixes:

 match: wrong reaction animation on point lost (sometimes the player was happy)
 match: you could be stuck in eagle view after match speed change
 match: the eagle-view was still displayed at the end of a match
 youth team: it was not possible to remove a mentor for a young player
 the manager photo was not imported correctly if imported more than once
 Mirra Adrejeva had records 'in the future'*
 reduction of a flickering effect on certain stadium elements
 minor localization fixes

Updates:

 extrem difficulty : less extrem but still the hardest 
 minor improvement in the understanding of simplified tactics
 add missing physics on some haircuts

Optimization:

 improved memory management of 3D assets: can improve game stability on some devices

 
*: fixes only availble for new career created from this version

notes.title: Hotfix 5.0.793
notes.notes:
Thank you very much for welcoming TM25.
We've had your initial feedback, we're sorry for any problems you've encountered, and here's a first batch of fixes.
Enjoy the game!

Major fixes:

 Using editor mode for players incorrectly modified data, in particular the turned pro date, which could then lead to errors and inconsistencies in tournament inscriptions
 Pro team players were abnormally refused entry to tournaments
 players : 15 players were corrupted in the database and could cause an error if they were in your pro team

 
Other fixes:

 player creation : radar chart is now updated with the player size during the creation or the edition of a player
 fantasy court : player photo after edition or import cas sometimes reseted and not taken into account
 mac only : the size of the game was unusually large (unnecessary files)
 texts : some tournaments categories had a wrong name
 match simulation : correction of players' reaction time when lobbed
 game plans : sometimes a personnalised gameplan was not found and this caused an error at the start of a match


Adds & Updates:

 New option in Settings>Graphics : Global illumination
 Minor update on players names
